purpose: Operator-facing specification for the Crucible key dashboard account; this file is not a credential and must not be imported as one.

item.name: Crucible key dashboard
item.notes: Create the actual secret only in the owner's password manager. Never copy it into Crucible source, GitHub Actions, chat, logs, or learning state. The dashboard must remain localhost-bound and password-protected.

requiredHumanActions: Create or select the dedicated password-manager item outside this repository.
Set a unique long password and enable MFA or passkey protection where supported.
Configure CRUCIBLE_KEY_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD only through the authorized local runtime secret boundary if the dashboard is started.
Do not put source-bundle encryption keys or workflow API tokens in this human dashboard item.
